description:
Produces the self-contained fat jar that the Python wheel mounts via --jars,
    for Spark 3.5.x / Scala 2.12 (WP-19 multi-shim wheel).

    WHY A SIBLING MODULE
    --------------------
    The pytest plugin mounts exactly ONE jar; a bundle must therefore contain
    exactly ONE shim. The 2.12 shim jar carries its own 2.12-compiled copies of
    the version-agnostic api classes (the shim module recompiles them for its
    Scala binary), so bundling both shims into one jar would both duplicate the
    api classes and put two PlanMutatorShim services on one classpath — the
    exact packaging error ShimDispatcher fails loudly on. Following the
    interceptor-bundle module's own guidance ("when a second Spark version is
    added, give it its own bundle module"), this module mirrors that shade
    configuration for the 2.12 combination.

    LINKAGE STATUS (read before relying on this jar)
    ------------------------------------------------
    Resolved (was the WP-19 flagged gap): this module — like
    interceptor-bundle-4.2 — RECOMPILES the version-agnostic api, dispatch and
    runtime layers FROM SOURCE against THIS combination's Spark 3.5.3 /
    Scala 2.12.18 (build-helper add-source below), instead of shading the
    reactor's 2.13-compiled artifacts. The erased JVM descriptors of the SPI
    differ between Scala 2.12 and 2.13 (e.g. the `Seq` in
    PlanMutatorShim.classify erases to different types; ShimDispatcher's
    asScala calls bind to different helpers), so shading the reactor's 2.13
    classes produced a jar that failed to link on a 2.12-built PySpark
    (NoSuchMethodError on scala.jdk.CollectionConverters). mutator-core is
    pure Java (no Spark imports, enforced by the CI gate) and is consumed as
    the reactor artifact.

    NO PACKAGE RELOCATION
    ---------------------
    Same rationale as interceptor-bundle: relocation would rename the
    PlanMutatorShim interface named in spark.sql.extensions and break the
    ServiceLoader contract. Distinct shims live in distinct packages and the
    plugin mounts exactly one bundle per session.

    Verify after building:
      jar tf target/interceptor-spark-3.5_2.12.jar | grep -E \
        "MutatorSparkExtension|MutantRegistry|ShimImpl|META-INF/services"
    All four must be present, and the services file must be named
      META-INF/services/io.github.wpunit13.mutator.api.PlanMutatorShim
    containing the UNRELOCATED implementation class name
    (io.github.wpunit13.mutator.spark35_212.ShimImpl).
